# Events research: Incheon/Bucheon venues, 2026-07-01 ~ 2026-10-31 (+ 2025 editions)

Researched 2026-11-12 from public web pages (news, ticketing pages, venue calendars). No ridership figures were looked up.
Conventions: "held = yes (post)" means a post-event report was fetched; "pre only" means only pre-event announcements were fetched;
"not verified" means no fetched page confirms it (search snippet, wiki-only, or nothing found). Times are KST.

### 2c. KBO postseason at SSG랜더스필드, October 2026
None. SSG finished 6th (65-74-5) and missed the postseason. All postseason games were in 잠실 / 광주 / 대구 / 수원
(WC 10-14; 준PO 10-17, 10-18, 10-20; PO 10-26, 10-27, 10-29, 10-30, 11-01; KS 11-03 ~ 11-08).
Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_KBO_League_season ; https://www.scorebase.kr/baseball/kbo-postseason ; https://isplus.com/article/view/isp202610110055 (2026-10-11, snippet).

## Not verified / open points
1. 불꽃야구 2026-10-31 at SSG랜더스필드: only pre-event articles; no result or attendance report found.
2. 불꽃야구 2026-06-20 (유신고, 인천): played or not is unclear (numbering conflict with the 06-28 고척 game).
3. SWF attendance (4만 forecast vs 8,135 wiki) and exact gate/end times; PLAVE attendance (42,616 wiki-only) and end time.
4. 부평풍물대축제: road-closure hours (both years), 2026 visitor count, and post-event confirmation of the 2025 edition.
5. 부천 07-29 kick-off: 19:00 (two sources) vs 19:30 (one source); attendance 2,689 is wiki-only.
6. 전국노래자랑 10-31: crowd size and end time not reported.
7. Completeness of "no other events" at 아시아드 (September calendar empty), 문학, 부천종합운동장 and 송도달빛축제공원.
8. Same-day overlap to note: 2026-10-31 (Sat) 14:00 had both 전국노래자랑 (아시아드 남측광장) and 불꽃야구 (SSG랜더스필드).
